name: University of Otago
summary: Dunedin, a medical school since 1875 and 15 residential colleges for first-years; entry from the full IB Diploma with 24 points.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma with 24 points, English Language A (SL or HL) or Language B HL, and any maths. IELTS or TOEFL cannot replace the English requirement. Limited-entry degrees select higher.

dates.label: Offshore international applications close for Semester 1 2027 (February start)
International applications close for Semester 2 2027 (12 July start)

programmes.name: Health Sciences First Year (HSFY)
programmes.credential: First year towards a health degree
programmes.about: The required first step to Dentistry, Medicine, Pharmacy, Physiotherapy and Medical Laboratory Science. Seven papers on the body and health, then a competitive second-year selection based on your HSFY results.
programmes.selectionNote: No subject is required, but chemistry, physics and calculus are recommended. For 2027 second-year international places: up to 25 in Medicine, 40 in Dentistry, 20 in Pharmacy.

flagshipSource.title: Otago HSFY: the required first year for Dentistry, Medicine, Pharmacy and Physiotherapy

programmes.name: Exercise and Sport Science
programmes.about: A Bachelor of Science major on biomechanics, motor control and learning, physiology and psychology, aligned with accrediting bodies in New Zealand and Australia, with a practicum of clinical, lab or field experience.
programmes.selectionNote: No specific Year 12 or 13 subjects are needed for admission, though a science background and basic numeracy help.

flagshipSource.title: Otago School of Physical Education, Sport and Exercise Sciences: number 1 department in New Zealand, 12th in the world

faculties.name: Division of Health Sciences
faculties.line: School leavers take Health Sciences First Year first; second-year places for international students are limited and competitive.

notes: EU citizens pay international fees: for 2027 Otago lists NZ$45,415 a year for Health Sciences First Year and NZ$44,520 to NZ$50,925 for Bachelor of Science majors.
Otago has 15 residential colleges for first-year students, with 2027 fees from NZ$21,488 to NZ$25,580; you apply for them separately.
Results are released to Otago electronically in July for the May IB session, so authorise the release of your results.
